festivals.what: Noche de Muertos, Janitzio island (Lake Pátzcuaro): held on the night of 1 to 2 November. In 2026 the island's cemetery was closed to the public because of rehabilitation works by Fonatur; island families still held their vigil and visitors watched from a raised viewing platform. The state tourism office expects normal access to the cemetery again in 2027, once the works finish. Rules and access for 2027 are not yet published.

culture-cycles.note: 2027 programme not yet published. The vigil is held by island families; visitors follow the community's and the state's instructions on the night.

sources.title: Janitzio está listo para recibir a turistas en Noche de Muertos

layers.authority: CONANP (Comision Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas), Reserva de la Biosfera Mariposa Monarca (Michoacan and Estado de Mexico)
layers.process: Entry fee of MXN 125 per person per day (about A$9.45; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (RBA 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040; Banco de Mexico FIX, USD 1 = MXN 18.7962)). Exempt: older adults, pensioners and retirees, people with disability and children under 12 (credential shown on entry). 75% off for students and teachers with a credential; 50% off for Mexican nationals and foreign residents who show an official document. Open 8:00 to 18:00 daily; the sanctuaries are open to visits from November to March. Visitors walk the trails with local guides.

sources.title: Mariposa Monarca
sources.authority: CONANP

zone-requirements.notes: Federal park fees and rules as published on CONANP's Descubre ANP page, which says amounts follow the Ley Federal de Derechos and can change. Other parks in this state aren't checked. The reserve also lies in the State of Mexico; it is held once here.

laws.rule: Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve: CONANP's code for responsible visitors says stay on the established trails; follow local guides; don't bring food, alcohol, sharp objects, firearms or pets into the sanctuaries; take nothing from the forest; no smoking or fires; stay quiet; no flash photography; don't eat in the sanctuary; don't disturb, touch or take butterflies; and stay no more than 15 minutes inside a sanctuary.

sources.title: Mariposa Monarca
sources.authority: CONANP
